name: open_banking_transactions
description: Open Banking transaction retrieval tool. PSD2-compliant, 300+ UK and European banks. Input: account_id (string, optional) — target account ID, defaults to first available. limit (number, optional, default 10, max 100) — controls number of transactions returned. from_date (string, optional, ISO 8601) — filters transactions from this date. Output: account_id (string), account_name (string), currency (string), balance (number), transactions (array of categorised transaction objects), total_returned (number), timestamp (ISO 8601 string). Returns live transaction and balance data.

account_id.description: Optional bank account ID to query. If omitted, returns data for the first available account.

limit.description: Number of transactions to return. Defaults to 10. Maximum 100.

from_date.description: Optional start date for transaction history in ISO format e.g. 2026-01-01
